why: The cap removed, which looks like more information and is less. A starved scope can report dozens of names into a log already interleaved across nine workers, burying the one line a reader needs; the '+N more' tail is what keeps the count honest while the message stays one line. Invisible whenever fewer than four tests fail, which is most of the time.
killedBy: runOne baseline check (the scoped tests must be green BEFORE any mutation) caps the named tests and says how many it withheld
